## Description

Add a `partio search <query>` command that performs a keyword search across the session content that each checkpoint stores on the local `partio/checkpoints/v1` branch (for example `prompt.txt` and `context.md`). The command reads that branch with git, as `partio rewind` does, so it needs no token and no network access. Should support `--json` for agent/script consumption, `--branch` for filtering by branch, and `--limit` for result count. Pretty-print results by default showing checkpoint ID, commit hash, branch, and a snippet of the session context.

## Why

As checkpoint history grows, users need a way to find relevant past sessions — e.g. 'when did we last touch auth?'. Search bridges raw checkpoint storage into a discoverable knowledge base, which is core to Partio's value proposition of preserving AI reasoning.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `partio search <query>` compiles and returns checkpoint results
- [ ] `partio search <query> --json` outputs valid JSON array
- [ ] `partio search <query> --branch <name>` filters results to that branch
- [ ] `partio search <query> --limit N` returns at most N results
- [ ] `partio search` works without a GitHub token and without network access
- [ ] Docs updated with search command usage
- [ ] `make lint && make test` pass
